faqs.q: How does the property acquisition process work?
faqs.a: BBG conducts full due diligence on every property — analyzing NOI, IRR, cash-on-cash returns, neighbourhood trends, and rental demand. Only properties meeting our strict criteria are acquired. Investors receive updates on portfolio performance.

faqs.q: What makes BBG different from other real estate investments?
faqs.a: BBG combines institutional-grade due diligence with accessible investment structures. We focus on Canada's strongest rental markets, offer preferred share structures for income stability, and provide fully managed exposure — no landlord responsibilities for investors.
